title: Make answer
description: The answer of the command make, on standard output: the vendor's id of the machine the adapter made for the request's dispatch_id, and, when the vendor returns it, the vendor's type of that machine. One dispatch_id makes at most one machine, so a second make with the same dispatch_id has the id of the machine that the first make with that dispatch_id made. The answer is at most 1 MiB. It has no version. The provisioner ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless the must_understand of the answer lists it. A writer marks a member that the provisioner must read, such as /id, by listing its pointer in must_understand. The provisioner refuses an answer that lists a pointer it does not define, as a failure of kind defect.

id.description: A machine's id at the vendor, as the vendor writes it: 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters with no space, and never exactly -.
The vendor's id of the machine the adapter made.

machine_type.description: The vendor's type of the machine, such as example-type. Absent when the vendor does not return the type.

must_understand.description: The members of the document that the reader must understand, each as a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) counted from the document, such as /id. List each once, at most 32. A pointer has no line feed, and writes ~ only as ~0 or ~1. Each pointer is to a member that this schema defines. The provisioner ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless must_understand lists it. It refuses an answer whose must_understand lists a pointer that it does not define, as a failure of kind defect.
